title: Text Redline Workbench & Diff Receipt
description: Deterministic line-level redline between an original and revised text or markdown document, with a cryptographic diff receipt (original/revised digests, diff-algorithm identifier, per-hunk digests, reviewer key, eddsa signature) and a hash-chained per-hunk accept/reject/comment disposition chain binding a replayable accepted-text digest. Built-in verifier recomputes the redline from a pasted receipt bundle and flags the exact hunk on any divergence. Paste-mode. Zero egress. Zero PII.

original.description: Original text or markdown document (pasted, never fetched)

revised.description: Revised text or markdown document (pasted, never fetched)

diff_receipt.description: original_digest, revised_digest, diff_algorithm, hunk_digests, execution_hash, audit_signature (eddsa)

hunk_receipts.description: One hash-chained receipt per hunk: hunk_digest, disposition, prev_hunk_receipt_digest, execution_hash

disposition_receipt.description: Closing receipt binding the accepted_text_digest, replayable from original + accepted hunks

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_redline_diff_receipt
mcp_tool_definition.description: Diff a pasted original and revised text or markdown document and return a diff receipt (original/revised digests, hunk digests, diff algorithm, reviewer key, eddsa signature) plus a hash-chained per-hunk disposition chain binding a replayable accepted-text digest.
